Current jurisdiction, unavailable-slot instructions and official refusal rules remain separate checks.

/study-in-latvia.question: What should I check before planning to study in Latvia from India?
/study-in-latvia.answer: Indian students admitted to an accredited Latvian institution apply for a long stay visa at the Embassy of Latvia in India. The visa is valid for 90 days. After entering Latvia, students apply for a residence permit at the Office of Citizenship and Migration Affairs.

/study-in-lithuania.question: What should I check before planning to study in Lithuania from India?
/study-in-lithuania.answer: Tuition fees vary by university and programme, and the European Commission study portal puts the average at from 1,300 euros a year for bachelor programmes, from 2,300 for master programmes and from 8,400 for doctoral programmes. More than 500 programmes are taught in English. Check each university for exact fees.

extra_faqs.question: What does ILMERA help compare for Lithuania study plans?
extra_faqs.answer: ILMERA compares tuition fees and living expenses to help students choose study destinations. ILMERA guides students on financial requirements, bank accounts and education loan information. Lender selection, loan decisions and account opening remain with the student and the relevant provider. Tax and investment advice are outside ILMERA's scope. This does not supply current visa maintenance thresholds, approval-rate comparisons or a personal quotation.

/study-in-slovakia.question: What should I check before planning to study in Slovakia from India?
/study-in-slovakia.answer: Full-time study in Slovak at public institutions can involve no tuition, while programmes taught in English or other foreign languages carry fees. Check the individual programme requirements and budget for living expenses separately. Admission decisions and deadlines are set by each institution.

/study-in-uk.question: What should I check before planning to study in UK from India?
/study-in-uk.answer: Most UK Student visa applicants need funding for the course fees shown on their CAS and living costs. Current monthly amounts are 1,171 pounds outside London or 1,529 pounds in London, for up to nine months. Some financial-evidence exemptions apply; check the rules for your circumstances.

extra_faqs.question: How should I assess a UK Master's against the Graduate visa dates?
extra_faqs.answer: For the Master's context, GOV.UK lists a 2-year Graduate visa for applications on or before 31 December 2026 and 18 months from 1 January 2027. These dates alone do not establish the value of a particular course. Compare the actual costs, course objectives and applicable conditions before deciding. Source: https://www.gov.uk/graduate-visa

extra_faqs.question: How does ILMERA help compare a UK course and check admission evidence?
extra_faqs.answer: ILMERA compares tuition fees and living expenses to help students choose study destinations. ILMERA reviews a student's eligibility, academic qualifications, English-language evidence and admission criteria. Programme costs, the applicant's priorities and current test/provider conditions still need checking. ILMERA does not provide advice on working during study or staying after study.
